'''2000 DecipherCon 8-Man (Friday, Brian Terwilliger)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event held in Kissimmee, Florida on 6 October 2000. [[Brian Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1331">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-twigg-at-d-con-2kd1331/ twigg-at-d-con-2k], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 12 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-twigg-at-d-con-2kd1331/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
